name: DrupalFit
description: Site fitness/health audit module: runs ~58 pluggable checks (security, performance, best-practice, content & config) grouped into scored categories, saves each run as a report-history entity, exposes a JSON API, and can pull SEO/accessibility scores from the external DrupalFit platform.
project_description: DrupalFit is a site audit and reporting module. From a single Reports page it runs a set of pluggable checks (about 58 ship in 1.1.3) covering security hardening, performance, coding/config best practices, and content & configuration hygiene, then scores the findings per category and overall and renders them grouped by severity with remediation help. Each run is stored as a fit_report_history content entity so results can be reviewed over time, and the same data is available as JSON at /api/v1/drupalfit-report. Checks are FitCheck plugins (PHP attribute discovery) sorted into FitCheckGroup plugins, so custom checks and groups can be added by any module. The core audit runs entirely on-site; an optional cloud connection to the DrupalFit platform (an API key configured in Settings) pulls SEO and accessibility scores and embeds the platform dashboard in an iframe tab. An optional submodule, drupalfit_report_export, adds CSV/JSON/printable-HTML export of a stored report.
